title: SAP Automotive JIT Call Control Operations Graph

graph_contract.agent_rule: When an edge crosses into an existing graph node, load the base knowledge graph before answering impact or recovery questions.

nodes.label: CANC
nodes.description: Classic cancellation action for a component group.

nodes.label: GOCC
nodes.description: Classic reversal of goods issue for JIT delivery.

nodes.label: DELI
nodes.description: Create JIT delivery; can also create HUs when configured.

nodes.label: CRHU
nodes.description: Create HU from component group.

nodes.label: DEHU
nodes.description: Unpack component group and delete HU.

nodes.label: HUPP
nodes.description: Generate deliverable HU in production.

nodes.label: PIN
nodes.description: Transfer component group to production.

nodes.label: POUT
nodes.description: Production completion message; status change without goods movement.

nodes.label: S2_IN_CANC
nodes.description: Next Generation interlinked cancellation that coordinates JIT call, warehouse request/tasks, outbound proxy and freight unit cancellation.

nodes.label: S2_IN_IDRV
nodes.description: Reverse inbound delivery.

nodes.label: S2_IN_GRRV
nodes.description: Reverse goods receipt in JIT-based integration.

nodes.label: S2_IN_ASRV
nodes.description: Reverse ASN.

nodes.label: S2_JC_OPEN
nodes.description: Reopen JIT call after inbound delivery deletion.

nodes.label: JITM / JITMX
nodes.description: Classic inbound JIT monitoring and action execution.

nodes.label: JITLOG
nodes.description: Classic JIT action history with successful/failed actions and before-state context.

nodes.label: EMJIT
nodes.description: IDoc monitor that joins technical IDoc processing with JIT business context.

nodes.label: JITE
nodes.description: Emergency status correction that bypasses Call Control and does not execute business actions.

nodes.label: JITQ
nodes.description: Display configured action network.

nodes.label: JIT6
nodes.description: Barcode entry for classic inbound JIT actions.

nodes.label: JIT7
nodes.description: Barcode entry with preset/standard values and sequence-oriented operator flow.

nodes.label: JITO6
nodes.description: Barcode entry for outbound JIT.

nodes.label: JITB
nodes.description: Reprocess goods movements.

nodes.label: JITK
nodes.description: Deliver JIT operations due for shipping.

nodes.label: SHD0
nodes.description: Transaction variants; useful for scanner/operator screen simplification.

nodes.label: JITCallInbound.PerformAction
nodes.description: Classic BAPI method to execute an action for component groups from a subsystem.

nodes.label: JITCallInbound.PerformActionFullCall
nodes.description: Classic BAPI method to execute an action for full calls.

nodes.label: JIT04_SET_ACTION_EXTERN
nodes.description: RFC function module for externally triggered JIT actions.

nodes.label: RJITARCH01
nodes.description: Archive JIT Inbound calls.

nodes.label: RJITOUTARCH01
nodes.description: Archive JIT Outbound calls.

nodes.label: Governed Cancellation Orchestrator
nodes.description: Project pattern that reverses business side effects in dependency order instead of changing status directly.

nodes.label: Reconcile Physical State
nodes.description: Compare JIT status with HU, warehouse, loading, goods movement and external supplier state.

nodes.label: Scanner Progress Confirmation
nodes.description: Resolve scanned physical identity, validate allowed action, execute action, confirm commit and log result.

nodes.label: No Direct Status Update
nodes.description: Normal recovery tools must use actions/APIs and linked-document reversals rather than database/status writes.

nodes.label: Cancellation Simulation
nodes.description: Preview all planned reversal steps before update mode.

nodes.label: Idempotent Restart
nodes.description: A failed multi-step cancellation can restart without repeating completed side effects.

nodes.label: HU / Loading Cut-Off
nodes.description: After packing/loading, automatic cancellation or resequence may require physical intervention.

nodes.label: JIT Action Log
nodes.description: Action ID, before/after status, result, source/user and messages.

nodes.label: IDoc Status History
nodes.description: Technical message path and reprocessing history.

nodes.label: Rack / HU Scanned
nodes.description: Operator has identified a physical handling object.

nodes.label: HU Packed
nodes.description: Physical sequence is now encoded in a handling unit or rack.

nodes.label: HU Loaded
nodes.description: Physical reversal cost and risk increase sharply.

nodes.label: Status Jump Without Reversal
nodes.description: SAP status looks corrected while delivery/HU/goods movement or external demand remains active.
